versions.content: For Synchronized and Offset Time Bases for which the StbM is configured as Time Slave or Time Gateway , an invocation of StbM_BusSetGlobalTime() shall set the GLOBAL_TIME_BASE bit within timeBaseStatus of the Time Base. Once set, the bit is never cleared.
